description: This Java class 'AccountNumberPreferencesTestBuilder' provides methods to generate JSON representations of account number preferences for different account types, such as client, loan, savings, groups, and center. It is used in testing scenarios to build test data related to account number configuration.

classes.name: AccountNumberPreferencesTestBuilder
classes.description: A helper class for constructing JSON test data for account number preferences related to different account types in testing scenarios.

methods.name: clientBuild
methods.description: Builds a JSON string representing account type and prefix type for a client account.

methods.name: loanBuild
methods.description: Builds a JSON string representing account type and prefix type for a loan account.

methods.name: savingsBuild
methods.description: Builds a JSON string representing account type and prefix type for a savings account.

methods.name: groupsBuild
methods.description: Builds a JSON string representing account type and prefix type for a groups account.

methods.name: centerBuild
methods.description: Builds a JSON string representing account type and prefix type for a center account.

methods.name: invalidDataBuild
methods.description: Builds a JSON string with custom account type and prefix type, potentially invalid data for testing validation.

methods.name: updatePrefixType
methods.description: Builds a JSON string to update only the prefix type field.
